# Index Legal

> Index Legal (working name "LegalHub") is a practice management platform for growing
> law firms: matters, clients, and documents in one secure, compliant workspace, with a
> client portal, document templates, e-signatures, and workflow tracking. South African
> B2B SaaS; subscriptions are invoiced directly, not processed in-app.

[PLACEHOLDER] Replace https://legalhub.example.com below with the real production domain
before launch (see frontend/src/constants/site.ts).

## Pages

- [Home](https://legalhub.example.com/): product overview, about, blog, and contact
  sections all on one page.
